slides.heading: N1 — Department List
slides.note: Departments govern kitchen ticket routing to appropriate printer stations.
steps: Open Settings and select Catalog tab.
Tap Department List.
Create departments (Kitchen, Bar, Grill, Fast Food, etc.).
Set display colour and sort order if shown.
Save. Departments help KOT routing and menu structure.

slides.heading: N2 — Menu items (Dishes)
slides.where: Location: Settings > Catalog > Menu items, or Masters > Dishes
slides.note: Always sync other tills immediately after adding or modifying dishes.
steps: Create categories first (Main / Sub).
Add dish: name, price, department, and tax rate.
Add photo if needed for visual till display.
Attach recipes, addons, and customizers as needed.
Save and sync other tills.

slides.heading: N3 — Menu details (Tax & Photos)
slides.note: Accurate product metadata ensures clean visual menus and compliant invoices.
steps: Open Menu details from Catalog.
Assign or audit applicable tax across dishes.
Update dish photos and extra product metadata.
Verify descriptions and portion parameters.
Save all changes.

slides.heading: N4 — Tax
slides.note: Tax changes impact all new bills and ZATCA compliance reporting.
steps: Open Tax master in Settings.
Confirm standard VAT rate (e.g., 15% in KSA).
Verify tax calculation parameters and active status.
Save configuration.
Do not change tax casually after go-live without accounts advice.

slides.heading: N5 — Tax Update (Bulk)
slides.note: Bulk update saves hours during tax audits or regulatory rate changes.
steps: Open Tax Update screen.
Select target category or group of products.
Apply tax rate to multiple products simultaneously.
Review summary confirmation before saving.
Check 1-2 sample bills after update.

slides.heading: N6 — Discount Master
slides.note: Control discounts carefully to protect profit margins and prevent cashier abuse.
steps: Open Discount master.
Create allowed discount types (percentage or fixed amount).
Set discount limits and name (Staff, VIP, Promo).
Save.
Only authorised roles should have rights to apply discounts.

slides.heading: N7 — Units
slides.note: Consistent units prevent recipe errors and inaccurate stock depletion.
steps: Open Units in Catalog settings.
Add measurement units for stock and recipes (kg, g, litre, piece, etc.).
Set decimal precision if supported.
Save.
Use the exact same units in ingredients, recipes, and POs.

slides.heading: N8 — Extra Charges
slides.note: Extra charges can be set as mandatory or optional per service channel.
steps: Open Extra Charges.
Add active charges (Service charge, Packing, Delivery fee).
Configure taxability on each charge if required by law.
Save.
Confirm charge calculates properly on floor tickets when applied.

slides.heading: N9 — Beverages Quantity Master
slides.where: Location: Settings > Catalog > Beverages Quantity Master
slides.note: Standard beverage quantities simplify barista and bartender operations.
steps: Open Beverages Quantity Master.
Define beverage sizes or serving quantities (Small, Medium, Large, 330ml).
Set display order.
Save.
Quantity tiers link to Beverage Price Master.

slides.heading: N10 — Beverages Price Master
slides.where: Location: Settings > Catalog > Beverages Price Master
slides.note: Ensures consistent pricing across all drink sizes without duplicate menu items.
steps: Open Beverages Price Master.
Set selling price for each beverage size tier.
Associate price to corresponding beverage items.
Save.
Place a test beverage order on Dine-in or Takeaway to verify price.

slides.heading: N11 — Online Price List
slides.where: Location: Online Module > Channel APIs & Price List
slides.note: Maintain price parity or intentional aggregator markups across all online channels.
steps: Open Online module from main navigation.
Review online order channels (HungerStation, Jahez, Keeta, Web, QR).
Verify aggregator channel pricing and markup if different from store.
Update online prices whenever in-store menu prices change.
Save and sync aggregator menus.
